values to routing actions (\"event\", \"meta\", \"skip\")\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// A Plugin configured with [source.envelope] for unwrapping JSONL envelopes.\n///\n/// # Example\n/// ```ignore\n/// let mut routing = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n/// routing.insert(\"message\".to_string(), \"event\".to_string());\n/// routing.insert(\"session\".to_string(), \"meta\".to_string());\n/// routing.insert(\"model_change\".to_string(), \"skip\".to_string());\n/// let plugin = envelope_jsonl_plugin(\"/tmp/*.jsonl\", routing);\n/// ```\nfn envelope_jsonl_plugin(\n    glob: &str,\n    type_routing: std::collections::HashMap<String, String>,\n) -> Plugin {\n    use std::collections::HashMap;\n\n    // Configure role_map for common transformations (toolResult -> tool_result)\n    let mut role_map = HashMap::new();\n    role_map.insert(\"toolResult\".to_string(), \"tool_result\".to_string());\n\n    Plugin {\n        plugin: PluginMeta {\n            name: \"envelope-test\".to_string(),\n            version: \"1.0\".to_string(),\n        },\n        source: Source {\n            paths: vec![glob.to_string()],\n            exclude: vec![],\n            format: LogFormat::Jsonl,\n            session_detection: SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession {\n                session_id_from: SessionIdSource::Filename,\n            },\n            tree: None,\n            truncation_limit: None,\n            envelope: Some(agentscribe::plugin::Envelope {\n                payload_field: \"message\".to_string(),\n                type_field: \"type\".to_string(),\n                type_routing,\n            }),\n            array: None,\n        },\n        parser: Parser {\n            // After envelope unwrapping, fields are accessed from the payload\n            timestamp: Some(\"timestamp\".to_string()), // Uses wrapper timestamp (^timestamp)\n            role: Some(\"role\".to_string()),           // From message.role\n            content: Some(\"content\".to_string()),     // From message.content\n            tool_name: Some(\"toolName\".to_string()),  // From message.toolName for tool results\n            project: Some(ProjectDetection::Field {\n                field: \"cwd\".to_string(),\n            }),\n            model: Some(ModelDetection::None),\n            role_map,\n            file_paths: Some(FilePathExtraction {\n                tool_call_field: None,\n                content_regex: Some(true),\n            }),\n            ..Default::default()\n        },\n        metadata: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Read RSS (Resident Set Size) in kilobytes from /proc/self/status.\n/// Returns None on non-Linux platforms.\nfn current_rss_kb() -> Option<u64> {\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\n    {\n        let status = fs::read_to_string(\"/proc/self/status\").ok()?;\n        for line in status.lines() {\n            if line.starts_with(\"VmRSS:\") {\n                let kb: u64 = line\n                    .split_whitespace()\n                    .nth(1)\n                    .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())?;\n                return Some(kb);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"linux\"))]\n    {\n        None\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load events from a JSONL session file.\nfn load_events_from_jsonl(path: &Path) -> Vec<Event> {\n    let content = fs::read_to_string(path).expect(\"failed to read jsonl\");\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    for line in content.lines() {\n        let line = line.trim();\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        // Parse the raw fixture format (Claude Code native format)\n        if let Ok(raw) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) {\n            // Extract role and content from the Claude Code format\n            let role_str = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"role\"))\n                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"user\");\n            let content = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"content\"))\n                .and_then(|c| c.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            // Skip non-conversation events (progress, file-history-snapshot)\n            let event_type = raw.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            if matches!(event_type, \"progress\" | \"file-history-snapshot\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let role = match role_str {\n                \"user\" => Role::User,\n                \"assistant\" => Role::Assistant,\n                \"tool_call\" => Role::ToolCall,\n                \"tool_result\" => Role::ToolResult,\n                \"system\" => Role::System,\n                _ => Role::User,\n            };\n\n            let ts = raw\n                .get(\"timestamp\")\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>().ok())\n                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n\n            let session_id = raw\n                .get(\"sessionId\")\n                .and_then(|s| s.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            let mut event = Event::new(ts, session_id, \"claude-code\".to_string(), role, content);\n\n            // Set tool name if present\n            if let Some(tool) = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"tool\"))\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n            {\n                event = event.with_tool(Some(tool.to_string()));\n            }\n\n            events.push(event);\n        }\n    }\n    events\n}\n\n/// Build a minimal manifest from events with a known turn count.\nfn make_manifest(session_id: &str, agent: &str, events: &[Event]) -> SessionManifest {\n    let turns = events\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|e| matches!(e.role, Role::User | Role::Assistant))\n        .count() as u32;\n    let mut m = SessionManifest::new(session_id.to_string(), agent.to_string());\n    m.turns = turns;\n    m.started = events.first().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n    m.ended = events.last().map(|e| e.ts);\n    m\n}\n\n// ─── Per-agent scrape tests Windsurf) pointing at a .vscdb file.\nfn sqlite_plugin(name: &str, path: &str) -> Plugin {\n    use std::collections::HashMap;\n    Plugin {\n        plugin: PluginMeta {\n            name: name.to_string(),\n            version: \"2.0\".to_string(),\n        },\n        source: Source {\n            paths: vec![path.to_string()],\n            exclude: vec![],\n            format: LogFormat::Sqlite,\n            session_detection: SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession {\n                session_id_from: SessionIdSource::Filename,\n            },\n            tree: None,\n            truncation_limit: None,\n            envelope: None,\n            array: None,\n        },\n        parser: Parser {\n            query: Some(\"SELECT key, value FROM cursorDiskKV ORDER BY rowid ASC\".to_string()),\n            key_filter: Some(\"^bubbleId:\".to_string()),\n            key_session_id_regex: Some(\"^bubbleId:([^:]+):\".to_string()),\n            role: Some(\"type\".to_string()),\n            content: Some(\"text\".to_string()),\n            timestamp: Some(\"createdAt\".to_string()),\n            project: Some(ProjectDetection::ParentDir),\n            model: Some(ModelDetection::None),\n            role_map: {\n                let mut m = HashMap::new();\n                m.insert(\"1\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"2\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"user\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"assistant\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m\n            },\n            ..Default::default()\n        },\n        metadata: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Scraping Cursor .vscdb fixture produces expected Windsurf) pointing at a .vscdb file.\nfn sqlite_plugin(name: &str, path: &str) -> Plugin {\n    use std::collections::HashMap;\n    Plugin {\n        plugin: PluginMeta {\n            name: name.to_string(),\n            version: \"2.0\".to_string(),\n        },\n        source: Source {\n            paths: vec![path.to_string()],\n            exclude: vec![],\n            format: LogFormat::Sqlite,\n            session_detection: SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession {\n                session_id_from: SessionIdSource::Filename,\n            },\n            tree: None,\n            truncation_limit: None,\n            envelope: None,\n            array: None,\n        },\n        parser: Parser {\n            query: Some(\"SELECT key, value FROM cursorDiskKV ORDER BY rowid ASC\".to_string()),\n            key_filter: Some(\"^bubbleId:\".to_string()),\n            key_session_id_regex: Some(\"^bubbleId:([^:]+):\".to_string()),\n            role: Some(\"type\".to_string()),\n            content: Some(\"text\".to_string()),\n            timestamp: Some(\"createdAt\".to_string()),\n            project: Some(ProjectDetection::ParentDir),\n            model: Some(ModelDetection::None),\n            role_map: {\n                let mut m = HashMap::new();\n                m.insert(\"1\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"2\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"user\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"assistant\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m\n            },\n            ..Default::default()\n        },\n        metadata: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Scraping Cursor .vscdb fixture produces expected ASC\".to_string()),\n            key_filter: Some(\"^bubbleId:\".to_string()),\n            key_session_id_regex: Some(\"^bubbleId:([^:]+):\".to_string()),\n            role:     model: Some(ModelDetection::None),\n            role_map: {\n                let mut m = HashMap::new();\n                m.insert(\"1\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"2\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"user\".to_string(), \"user\".to_string());\n                m.insert(\"assistant\".to_string(), \"assistant\".to_string());\n                m\n            },\n            ..Default::default()\n        },\n        metadata: None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Scraping Cursor .vscdb fixture produces expected   }\n}\n\n/// Read RSS (Resident Set Size) in kilobytes from /proc/self/status.\n/// Returns None on non-Linux platforms.\nfn current_rss_kb() -> Option<u64> {\n    #[cfg(target_os = \"linux\")]\n    {\n        let status = fs::read_to_string(\"/proc/self/status\").ok()?;\n        for line in status.lines() {\n            if line.starts_with(\"VmRSS:\") {\n                let kb: u64 = line\n                    .split_whitespace()\n                    .nth(1)\n                    .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())?;\n                return Some(kb);\n            }\n        }\n        None\n    }\n    #[cfg(not(target_os = \"linux\"))]\n    {\n        None\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load events from a JSONL session file.\nfn load_events_from_jsonl(path: &Path) -> Vec<Event> {\n    let content = fs::read_to_string(path).expect(\"failed to read jsonl\");\n    let mut events = Vec::new();\n    for line in content.lines() {\n        let line = line.trim();\n        if line.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        // Parse the raw fixture format (Claude Code native format)\n        if let Ok(raw) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(line) {\n            // Extract role and content from the Claude Code format\n            let role_str = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"role\"))\n                .and_then(|r| r.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"user\");\n            let content = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"content\"))\n                .and_then(|c| c.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            // Skip non-conversation events (progress, file-history-snapshot)\n            let event_type = raw.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            if matches!(event_type, \"progress\" | \"file-history-snapshot\") {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            let role = match role_str {\n                \"user\" => Role::User,\n                \"assistant\" => Role::Assistant,\n                \"tool_call\" => Role::ToolCall,\n                \"tool_result\" => Role::ToolResult,\n                \"system\" => Role::System,\n                _ => Role::User,\n            };\n\n            let ts = raw\n                .get(\"timestamp\")\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>().ok())\n                .unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n\n            let session_id = raw\n                .get(\"sessionId\")\n                .and_then(|s| s.as_str())\n                .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                .to_string();\n\n            let mut event = Event::new(ts, session_id, \"claude-code\".to_string(), role, content);\n\n            // Set tool name if present\n            if let Some(tool) = raw\n                .get(\"message\")\n                .and_then(|m| m.get(\"tool\"))\n                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n            {\n                event = event.with_tool(Some(tool.to_string()));\n            }\n\n            events.push(event);\n        }\n    }\n    events\n}\n\n/// Build a minimal manifest from events with a known turn count.\nfn make_manifest(session_id: &str, agent: &str, events: &[Event]) -> SessionManifest {\n    let turns = agent.to_string());\n    m.turns = turns;\n    m.started = events.first().map(|e| e.ts).unwrap_or_else(Utc::now);\n    m.ended = events.last().map(|e| e.ts);\n    m\n}\n\n// ─── Per-agent scrape tests
